user.title: Connect TVCanvas
user.description: In the TVCanvas app: Settings → Home Assistant → Connect Home Assistant. Enter the code it shows (valid for 10 minutes).

data_description.code: The 12 characters shown in the app, with or without dashes.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Only change this to test against a development server. Enter just the server's address, for example {default_url}.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect TVCanvas
reauth_confirm.description: TVCanvas no longer accepts this Home Assistant. Get a new code in the TVCanvas app and enter it here.

data_description.code: The 12 characters shown in the app, with or without dashes.

error.code_format: That isn't a TVCanvas code. Enter the 12 characters the app shows, for example K7QM-2XRA-P4NB (dashes and spaces are optional).
error.invalid_code: TVCanvas Cloud didn't accept this code: it's wrong, already used, or expired (a code lasts 10 minutes). Get a new code in the TVCanvas app and enter it here.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach TVCanvas Cloud. Check that Home Assistant is connected to the internet and that the server URL is right, then try again.
error.wrong_server: This server doesn't accept Home Assistant codes. Check the server URL (for example {default_url}).
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.server_error: TVCanvas Cloud has a problem right now. Try again in a few minutes.
error.unexpected_answer: TVCanvas Cloud gave an answer Home Assistant doesn't understand. Check the server URL and that the TVCanvas integration is up to date.
error.invalid_url: Enter the server's address starting with https://, for example {default_url} (http:// works only for a server on your local network).
error.url_not_base: Enter only the server's address, without a path, for example {default_url}.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log and try again.
